notes.107r.33a: 107r.33a: 'mikla' ('great') qualifies the thing Thorvald was making, named in the line before. moðskegg, 'Chaff-beard', is an insulting name for Thorvald.

nodes.text: great one. Alf called loudly: Is Chaff-beard
inside? Open the door! He says: You two shall
never come in here. Alf said: Now you will
do something evil. And you are the worst of men, as is said,
and not of one shape; and you are a troll, though you look like a man.
He does not bear that, and leapt out, and took in each hand one
of the boys, dashes them down against the stone, so that
the brains spatter all around. Finnbogi sees this and runs over there
